heroTitle: Learn AI applied to work, with no programming required
lead: Recorded courses in three levels, from generative AI and prompt engineering to designing and managing AI agents. For professionals, managers, and companies. Commercial information and availability must be confirmed before engagement.
contextTitle: How do you build AI skills at your own pace?
context: Professionals, managers, and companies may need different starting points to understand and apply artificial intelligence. The Academy organizes learning in three levels, but titles, detailed content, and current access terms must be confirmed before choosing.
solutionText: Onsmart.AI Academy offers recorded courses with no programming required, covering topics from generative AI and prompt engineering to designing and managing AI agents. The briefing mentions individual or per-employee licensing and 12 months of access; pricing and any free offering are subject to confirmation.
audiences: Professionals who want to learn about generative AI and prompt engineering.
Managers interested in understanding design and management of AI agents.
Companies evaluating training for employees, with individual or per-employee licensing to be confirmed.
